en: Venus rotates so slowly that a single day on the planet actually lasts longer than its entire year.
The moon experiences deep moonquakes caused by the gravitational pull of Earth stretching and squeezing its interior.
Pumice is the only rock that naturally floats on water because it is full of trapped volcanic gas bubbles.
A single bolt of lightning heats the surrounding air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, making it five times hotter than the sun's surface.
A single square meter of healthy soil can contain over 200 earthworms that eat their own body weight in dirt daily.
About 68 percent of Earth's fresh water is frozen and trapped inside glaciers and ice caps rather than flowing in rivers.
A single teaspoon of a neutron star would weigh about six billion tons on Earth due to its extreme crushed density.
In the deep ocean, a tsunami wave can travel as fast as a jet plane, reaching speeds up to 800 kilometers per hour.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a giant swirling storm that has been raging for over 300 years and is wider than Earth.
Talc is the softest mineral on the Mohs hardness scale, while diamond is the hardest natural mineral known to science.
A typical fluffy white cumulus cloud actually weighs about 500,000 kilograms because it contains so many suspended water droplets.
Astronaut footprints on the moon will remain perfectly intact for millions of years because the moon lacks wind and water to erase them.
